newsitem.title: UK: ED&F Man says guaranteed bond issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: ED&F Man says guaranteed bond issue oversubscribed.

text.p: ED & F Man Investment Products said on Friday it had trebled the size of its guaranteed active investment bond to over $70 million because of strong demand.
Man-IP 220 Ltd, which issued the bond, will launch a second series early next year.

The bond structure combines 100 percent investment in ED & F Man Investments' AHL diversified trading programme with, using a loan facility, a further 60 percent investment in Man-Glenwood Multi Strategy Fund Ltd. The face value of each bond is guaranteed by Chase Manhattan Bank Ltd at maturity.
